// getPerformanceMetricsResult.js
(function(performanceMetricsFunctionName) {
  try {
    if (window[performanceMetricsFunctionName]) {
      return window[performanceMetricsFunctionName]();
    }
  } catch(e) {}
  return null;
})('__PLACEHOLDER_FUNCTION_NAME__');
// performanceMetrics.js
(function(performanceMetricsFunctionName) {
    const metricsKey = performanceMetricsFunctionName + "Metrics";
    window[metricsKey] = {
        FP: 0,
        FCP: 0,
        LCP: 0,
        CLS: 0
    };

    console.log("Starting performance metrics collection");

    // First Paint and First Contentful Paint
    const paintObserver = new PerformanceObserver((entries, observer) => {
        entries.getEntries().forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.name === 'first-paint') {
                window[metricsKey].FP = entry.startTime;
                console.log(`FP: ${window[metricsKey].FP}`);
            } else if (entry.name === 'first-contentful-paint') {
                window[metricsKey].FCP = entry.startTime;
                console.log(`FCP: ${window[metricsKey].FCP}`);
                observer.disconnect(); // 停止观察 paint 条目
            }
        });
    });
    paintObserver.observe({ type: 'paint', buffered: true });

    // Largest Contentful Paint
    const lcpObserver = new PerformanceObserver((entries) => {
        entries.getEntries().forEach(entry => {
            window[metricsKey].LCP = entry.startTime;
            console.log(`LCP: ${window[metricsKey].LCP}`);
        });
    });
    lcpObserver.observe({ type: 'largest-contentful-paint', buffered: true });

    // Cumulative Layout Shift
    const clsObserver = new PerformanceObserver((entries) => {
        let cls = 0;
        entries.getEntries().forEach(entry => {
            if (!entry.hadRecentInput) {
                cls += entry.value;
                console.log(`CLS entry: ${entry.value}, total CLS: ${cls}`);
            }
        });
        window[metricsKey].CLS = cls;
        console.log(`Final CLS: ${window[metricsKey].CLS}`);
    });
    clsObserver.observe({ type: 'layout-shift', buffered: true });

    // 延迟一段时间后停止观察 LCP 和 CLS
    setTimeout(() => {
        lcpObserver.disconnect();
        console.log('LCP observer disconnected');
        clsObserver.disconnect();
        console.log('CLS observer disconnected');
    }, 5000); // 5秒后停止观察

    // 将指标存储在一个局部变量中
    window[performanceMetricsFunctionName] = function() {
        return window[metricsKey];
    };
})('__PLACEHOLDER_FUNCTION_NAME__');
